  • Constructor Details

    • CliShipHandAndStash

      public CliShipHandAndStash(ShipBoard shipBoard, String nickname)
      Creates a new CLI representation of a ship's hand and stash. Initializes the hand with the last component of the ship board, or an empty hand if none exists. Initializes the stash with the components currently stashed in the ship board.
      Parameters:
      shipBoard - The ship board containing the components
      nickname - The nickname of the player owning this ship
